title: Full Stack Developer (Java & Flutter)
description: Soliner Bilgi Teknolojileri olarak ekibimize katılacak; mevcut web ve mobil uygulamalarımızın teknik sorumluluğunu üstlenebilecek, ürünlerimizi geliştirebilecek ve yeni projelerimizde aktif rol alabilecek Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. ARADIĞIMIZ NİTELİKLER Yazılım geliştirme alanında en az 3 yıl profesyonel deneyim sahibi, Java ve Spring Boot ile backend geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, Flutter ve Dart ile mobil uygulama geliştirme deneyimine sahip, Angular ve TypeScript kullanarak web uygulamaları geliştirmiş, PostgreSQL ile veritabanı tasarımı, SQL sorguları ve performans optimizasyonu konularında bilgi sahibi, RESTful API geliştirme ve üçüncü taraf sistem entegrasyonlarında deneyimli, Git ve versiyon kontrol süreçlerine hâkim, Mevcut projelerin kod yapısını analiz ederek geliştirme ve bakım süreçlerini bağımsız şekilde yürütebilen, Yazılım mimarisi, temiz kod ve sürdürülebilir geliştirme prensiplerini benimseyen, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve teknik sorumluluk alma becerileri güçlü, Daha önce canlı ortamda kullanılan, gerçek kullanıcıları bulunan yazılım projelerinde görev almış. İŞ TANIMI Mevcut web ve mobil uygulamaların teknik yapısını analiz ederek geliştirme süreçlerini devralmak, Backend, frontend ve mobil uygulama katmanlarında yeni özellikler geliştirmek, Uygulamaların bakım, hata giderme, performans iyileştirme ve sürüm yönetimi süreçlerini yürütmek, Veritabanı yapısını ve API entegrasyonlarını yönetmek ve geliştirmek, İş ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek sürdürülebilir teknik çözümler üretmek, Mevcut uygulamaların ölçeklenebilirliğini, güvenliğini ve performansını artırmak, Yeni yazılım projelerinin analiz, tasarım, geliştirme, test ve canlıya alma aşamalarında aktif sorumluluk üstlenmek. TERCİH SEBEBİ OLACAK YETKİNLİKLER Web ve mobil uygulamaların birlikte çalıştığı projelerde deneyim, Uçtan uca proje geliştirme ve canlı ortam yönetimi tecrübesi, Docker, CI/CD ve deployment süreçlerine aşinalık, Uygulama mağazalarına (Google Play / App Store) mobil uygulama yayınlama deneyimi, Teknik dokümantasyon hazırlama ve mevcut projelerde bilgi aktarımı süreçlerini yönetebilme. ÇALIŞMA MODELİ İstanbul İkitelli'deki ofisimizde haftada 3 gün ofisten, 2 gün uzaktan çalışıyoruz. Mevcut ürünlerimizin gelişiminde doğrudan sorumluluk alacak, teknik karar süreçlerine katkıda bulunacak ve uzun vadeli projelerde aktif rol üstlenecek ekip arkadaşımızı arıyoruz.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: About Orbina Orbina builds AI agents for customer experience and operations. Our agents use company knowledge, integrate with business systems, take actions, request human approval when required, and help teams understand what their customers struggle with. The Role You will own product problems end to end, from the first screen to the last API call. Responsibilities • Turn customer problems into working features across frontend, backend and data. • Work with product, design and customers to clarify requirements. • Make decisions on data models, interfaces, failure handling and system boundaries. • Question architecture before extending it; prefer removing complexity to adding layers. • Use coding agents daily, and review and verify everything they produce. • Ship, measure the outcome, and iterate based on evidence. Example Projects • Handing a conversation from an AI agent to a human without losing context. • Approval flows for actions that must not run automatically. • Simplifying complex customer journeys. • Diagnosing performance issues across the database, network and frontend. What We Look For • Strong experience with agentic development: giving agents context, splitting work, and reviewing their output critically. • A product mindset: knowing who needs a feature, why, and whether it worked. • Sound judgment at every level, from component design to service architecture. • Clear, direct and early communication, including about risks and mistakes. Nice to Have • Startup experience. • Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). • Familiarity with authentication, databases, queues, networking or observability. • Python, React or PostgreSQL (our current stack). We value reasoning, ownership and customer impact over any specific language, degree or years of experience. How to Apply Send your profile with short answers to the following: 1. Describe a product problem you owned from idea to real use. 2. What is something you decided not to build, and why? 3. How do coding agents fit into your work today? Brief, candid answers are preferred.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Hakkımızda Greenfocus medya ajansı olarak, Kırkdan fazla markaya inhouse dijital dönüşüm, kreatif altyapılar, web ve mobil yazılım çözümleri sunuyoruz. Geniş teknoloji stack’imizde hem kurumsal web sistemlerimizi hem de mobil projelerimizi büyütecek; yapay zekâ destekli kodlama (AI-assisted coding) araçlarını günlük workflow’una entegre etmiş bir Mid-Level Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. Aranan Nitelikler • Genel Deneyim: Web (Responsive UI) ve mobil uygulama geliştirme süreçlerinde uçtan uca 2–4 yıl aktif deneyim. • AI-Assisted Coding: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Claude API vb. yapay zekâ kodlama araçlarını aktif kullanarak geliştirme hızını ve kod kalitesini artırabilen. • Backend Yetkinlikleri: * Java & Spring Boot (Core): Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security ve çok modüllü Maven mimarisine hakimiyet. * PHP & Diğer Teknolojiler: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 11 mimarisine hakim veya hızlı adapte olabilen; ayrıca Node.js ve Python ekosistemlerinde bilgi/deneyim sahibi. • Frontend & Mobil Yetkinlikleri: * Web (Responsive): JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Vue.js / Nuxt.js (SSR) ile tam uyumlu (responsive) web arayüzleri geliştirme tecrübesi (Vue 2/3 geçiş vizyonu olan). * Mobil Uygulama: React Native ile cross-platform mobil uygulama geliştirme becerisi. • Veritabanı & Altyapı: * PostgreSQL (tercihen PostGIS/konum verisi), Redis (cache), Docker ve Jenkins CI/CD süreçlerine yatkınlık. * Git ve GitHub ortamında düzenli workflow disiplini. Sorumluluklar • Ajans bünyesindeki kurumsal Java (Spring Boot) ve Laravel backend sistemlerinin, responsive web sitelerinin ve React Native mobil uygulamalarının geliştirme ve bakım süreçlerini yürütmek. • Yapay zekâ kodlama asistanlarını (AI assistants) yetkin şekilde kullanarak web ve mobil modülleri hızlı, modüler ve temiz bir mimariyle ayağa kaldırmak. • Legacy mimarilerden güncel yapılara (ör. Nuxt 2/Vue 2 → Vue 3/Nuxt 3) geçiş süreçlerinde ve yeni mobil/web özelliklerinin yayına alınmasında aktif rol oynamak. • Tasarım ve proje ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak kullanıcı deneyimi yüksek, mobil uyumlu ve ölçeklenebilir çözümler üretmek. Neler Sunuyoruz? • Esnek Çalışma Modeli: Kurum kültürümüze ve ekibe alışma sürecinde Onsite (Ofis), oryantasyon sonrasında Hibrit çalışma imkânı. • Ulaşım & Yemek: Personel Servisi imkânı ve Ofis Yemekhanesi. • Web, mobil ve yapay zekâ odaklı araçları kapsayan geniş bir teknoloji stack'inde gelişme fırsatı. • Dinamik, yenilikçi ve hızlı kararların alındığı ajans kültürü. Başvuru: Özgeçmişinizi ve GitHub / App Store / Play Store / Portfolyo bağlantılarınızı doğrudan LinkedIn üzerinden iletebilirsiniz.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We're hiring: Senior Full Stack Developer (Remote) EnigmaKey is a cybersecurity company working with partners around the world. We build secure software that has to hold up under real-world attack, and we're growing our engineering team. We're looking for a senior full stack developer who can own features end to end, from database to UI, and who treats security as part of the craft rather than an afterthought. What you'll do * Design, build and maintain secure web applications and APIs end to end * Own backend services in Python and the frontends built on top of them * Apply secure coding practices and work closely with our security team on threat modelling, code review and penetration test findings * Make architecture decisions and help raise the engineering bar across the team What we're looking for * 10+ years of professional software development experience with a strong full stack track record * Strong Python (FastAPI, Django or Flask) * Modern frontend experience: TypeScript and React, or a comparable framework * Solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL preferred) and API design (REST, GraphQL) * Docker, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) * Practical cybersecurity knowledge: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect), secrets management * Fluent professional English, written and spoken (required) * Comfortable working remotely with a few hours of overlap with North American time zones Nice to have * Experience in security, defence or other regulated industries * Security certifications such as OSCP, CEH or CISSP * Hands-on experience with Burp Suite, vulnerability scanners or penetration testing workflows

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Backend Enginee r with strong technical and communication skills to contribute throughout the development lifecycle of products in various exciting domains, which are realized with Commencis’ expertise in a fast-paced team environment. If you are curious by nature, adaptive, collaborative, and always one step ahead, then join us and be a Commencer! Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable and high-performance backend systems using Java and Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, etc.) Contribute to system architecture decisions and lead the design of both monolithic and microservices-based solutions Develop and maintain Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers and core backend services to support scalable applications Strong understanding of design principles, design patterns, and architectural best practices (DDD, TDD, and layered architecture) Build and maintain RESTful APIs and ensure high availability and performance Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and QA to deliver high-quality solutions Ensure code quality through code reviews, best practices, and clean code principles Write and maintain unit and integration tests Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing systems Participate in CI/CD processes and support deployment activities Mentor junior developers and contribute to team knowledge sharing Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices Qualifications BSc/MSc/PhD degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development with Java Strong experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, etc.) Strong understanding of OOP principles, design patterns, and scalable system design Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems Hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis) Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) is a plus Basic knowledge of front-end technologies such as JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 Strong unit test and debugging skills Proficiency in code versioning tools such as Git Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus Strong sense of analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Excellent attention to detail Highly effective time management and multitasking skills Strong verbal and written communication skills in English Experience with AI technologies and a strong interest in learning and applying them in real-world use cases Proficiency in AI-assisted development practices, with the ability to effectively integrate AI tools into daily software development workflows. Experience or domain knowledge in banking and financial services is considered a plus Why Commencis? We want people to thrive at Commencis. Here’s what Commencers like about working here: Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, private health insurance, pension and retirement plans through a company-backed pension system, meal card, commute compensation, work-from home support and paid birthday off. Happier Weekdays: We offer flexible working hours including remote working option. Online events, guest speakers, refreshments in the office, meeting-light culture, and many more to enjoy the weekdays. Never Stop Learning: We support learning and development programs for almost anything. Additionally, we provide access to leading online e-learning platforms like Udemy and various libraries. Community & Socials: We are a tight-knit community that loves gathering. Our social activities include happy hours, workshops, new year party, breakfast & lunch get-togethers, movie nights, and our Summer Festival. Open Culture: We maintain a flat organizational structure with a culture of direct and open communication. We value Commencers’ voices and address any suggestions and questions you may have. About Commencis Join us in paving the way for a thriving digital society! Commencis has more than two decades of expertise in the world of experience design, software engineering and cloud technologies. Our products and solutions are used by leading brands in financial services, insurance, airlines and retail in more than 20 countries. We help our clients around the globe to commence their next evolution and pave the way for a thriving digital society. We love discovering what’s next. We value collaboration, curiosity, and an open mindset at work. If you share the same passion with our fellow Commencers, then let us unleash your world-class potential! We will process your personal data as part of our recruitment procedures. To find out more, please consult our Candidate Privacy Notices . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
